The M4 Sherman's armor was deliberately kept light to maximize speed and mobility, but crews in the field improvised protection anyway. From the 75mm gun to the British-developed Firefly with its devastating 76.2mm cannon, the Sherman evolved through variants like the Easy 8—proving that innovation happened on the battlefield, not just in the factory. #simplehistory
